absolutely shocking lack of compassion or empathy.\n\nAfter an incredibly traumatic experience with the Laos poisonings in November 2024,  I had initially emailed asking for a letter to give to my insurer on the 28th November. I had been advised that it would cost £30 which I had agreed to. I then had to email again to chase it and then was told it would be ready on the 9th December. I rang the GP later that day and was told that 'it wouldn't be done instantly' and that I would have to wait. I then called again this morning (17th December) to be told that it was still not done. Then I receive this message (see upload), and it appears it is now £45. I had already been told it could be sent via email as I was relying on family members for lifts, but it appears that I am not trustworthy enough and will need to pay before I can collect the letter. As I am now unemployed without a car and am extremely traumatised- this is completely unacceptable. Absolutely no compassion or empathy.  Will be considering a PALS complaint and/or CQC complaint when I am fit enough to do this. I cannot imagine a worse situation than what I have experienced- absolutely the worst way possible of dealing with this.\n\nI would strongly recommend the practice manager coach their staff on how to deal with sensitive situations such as this. No one should have to deal with this!\n\nUpdate- I was called to confirm that it was £30. No apology for the confusion caused by other staff not knowing the correct price.
